title: In JetBrains Datalore before 2026.2.4 unauthenticated users could execute code via published interactive reports…
description: JetBrains Datalore versions before 2026.2.4 contain a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated users to execute code via published interactive reports. This flaw could lead to full compromise of confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the affected system. The vulnerability is identified as CVE-2026-123280 with a high severity score of 8.1.
